events.evidence: Hamas hands over the 20 remaining living Israeli hostages to the Red Cross
Nineteen security forces are killed in two Pakistani airstrikes in Spin Boldak and Bahramcha, Afghanistan
The Dutch government invokes the Goods Availability Act to seize control of the Chinese-owned semiconductor manufacturer Nexperia

label.note: Hostage-prisoner exchange advances Gaza peace plan; Pakistan strikes and Nexperia seizure add friction.
